description: O72 Protosynthesis in Drought's sun: both Paradox Pokémon get the condition at the battle start (after Drought: priority -2). Roaring Moon's best stat is Attack, so its Strength is 5325/4096; Great Tusk's best stat is Defense (32 SP), so it takes the hit with 5325/4096 Defense. Torkoal and Iron Bundle (Quark Drive, no Electric Terrain) Harden.
